VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Now on paper, this looked UNSTOPPABLE. Because Saudi Arabia had EVERYTHING to make this project possible. They had TRILLIONS of dollars in cash. They had the best architects in the world. They had legendary consultants from McKINSEY and BCG. They had SAM ALTMAN, MASAYOSHI SON, and TRAVIS KALANICK as their advisors. And they had a $500 BILLION budget that they promised to grow to whatever the project needed. So the world was CONVINCED that if any country on Earth could pull this off, it would be SAUDI ARABIA.
